title: Barnyard Dash
tagline: Race your farm pet through mud, hurdles, hay and tight turns.
description: A third-person 3D, skill-first pet obstacle race across five farm courses. Race a quick field of CPU rivals at Rookie, Pro or Champion, chase a Grand Prix cup for a trophy on your farm, or race other players online in rooms of up to eight pets. Speed and Strength help a little; your line and your jumps decide it.
status: Playable - Quick Race, Grand Prix cups, and online races for 2-8 pets
